data.body: F12 validation is green. On base `b04405e20d4`, D1 and D2 passed, D3 passed with 36 tests, D4 passed with 221 tests, D6 passed with 53 tests, `make lint` passed, and `make typecheck` passed across 640 source files. Those runs included all nine restored held-out cases. `origin/main` then advanced to `4b6f0cfca40` through three paths disjoint from F12. The clean rebase preserved the Change-Id. D1, D2, D6, plan-attestation currency, and commit-ticket resolution passed again on the new base. The standalone scratch oracle is an extraction bundle without its target-file imports. Direct collection stopped before any product test, while the restored cases passed in D3 and D4.
